Search an English translation to look in English, or an Arabic text to search the original. Finding nothing comes back as an empty result rather than an error, so a workflow can branch on it. No API key required.

search_quran.name: search_quran

description: The Qur'an, from Al Quran Cloud: the full Arabic text with 118 translations in 49 languages, six commentaries, three transliterations and 190 recitations. Get a single verse, a whole chapter, one of the 30 juz or a page of the printed mushaf, search every verse for a word or a phrase, and get a verse of the day that is the same for everyone all day. Every verse comes back in Arabic and in the translation you choose, with a link to the recitation when you want one. No account or API key required.
